newsitem.title: ITALY: Insurer Sai H1 net steady, income higher.
newsitem.headline: Insurer Sai H1 net steady, income higher.

text.p: Italian insurer Sai posted first half 1996 net profit of 44.2 billion lire against 43.6 billion in the same 1995 period.
It said in a statement that group premium income rose 24.9 percent to 2.31 trillion lire while parent company premium income rose 8.8 percent to 1.77 trillion lire.

On a group level, life premium income rose 26.9 percent to 320 billion lire and non-life premium income rose 24.6 percent to 1.99 trillion lire. Total investments were up 4.84 percent at 9.35 trillion lire.
